description: The line plot illustrates the relative change in precision as a function of the number of tokens used in a KV cache compression algorithm. The x-axis represents different layers of a neural network, ranging from Layer1-4 to Layer29-32. The y-axis measures the relative change in precision, with values ranging from -15% to 5%. The plot includes four lines representing different configurations: LB-Avg of 1×tokens, 16-bit (red line with square markers), RULER4k of 2×tokens, 8-bit (blue line with circle markers), and RULER4k of 1×tokens, 16-bit (yellow line with diamond markers). Additionally, there is a baseline of 4×tokens, 4-bit (dashed gray line). The plot shows that the relative change in precision varies across different layers and configurations, with some configurations experiencing a decrease in precision, while others show an increase. The baseline remains relatively stable across the layers.
